description: Contains a snapshot of Dialogflow CX flow configurations within an agent.

schema.name: runtime
schema.description: The timestamp when the data extraction process was run.

schema.name: run_guid
schema.description: A unique identifier for each execution run of the data extraction process.

schema.name: agent_project_id
schema.description: The Google Cloud project ID of the Dialogflow CX agent.

schema.name: agent_location_id
schema.description: The GCP region or location of the Dialogflow CX agent (e.g., 'us-central1').

schema.name: agent_id
schema.description: The unique identifier (UUID) for the Dialogflow CX agent.

schema.name: agent_name
schema.description: The human-readable display name of the Dialogflow CX agent.

schema.name: flow_id
schema.description: The unique identifier (UUID) for the Dialogflow CX flow.

schema.name: flow_name
schema.description: The human-readable display name of the Dialogflow CX flow.

schema.name: description
schema.description: The user-provided description of the flow's purpose.

schema.name: flow_settings
schema.description: A JSON string containing detailed configuration for the flow, such as NLU settings, event handlers, and transition routes.
